title: HungryGPU maps local AI models and patches to the hardware that can run them
friendlyTitle: HungryGPU helps you find AI models that fit your computer
summary: HungryGPU is a searchable catalogue of open models, community setups, performance measurements, hardware-specific patches and relevant papers. It labels estimates separately from measured runs and exposes its catalogue through MCP without requiring an account.
friendlySummary: HungryGPU collects models, setup guides, speed tests and software changes. You can filter the information for the hardware you own.
whyItMatters: Local AI advice is often too generic to answer the question that matters: what will run well on the machine already on your desk. Hardware-specific evidence can save time and money before downloading a model, changing an inference engine or applying a patch.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can help you avoid downloading a model that is too large or using a setting that does not support your machine.
